description: [structures] Running out of fuel, part 3 of 3: the Astrahus is at low power with no fuel expiry, the owner has the low-fuel alert (181), services offline (198) and went-low-power (207) notifications, and the client GM menu's /structure abandontimer takes it to abandoned (upkeep 3).

setup.note: a pilot on its own account

setup.clientEval: agent.up_fuelsid = [k for k, v in sm.RemoteSvc('structureDirectory').GetMyCorporationStructures().items() if v.itemName.endswith('Fuel Test Astrahus')][0]
ns = sm.RemoteSvc('notificationMgr').GetAllNotifications(); sid = str(agent.up_fuelsid); all(any(n.typeID == t and sid in str(n.data) for n in ns) for t in (181, 198, 207))
setup.note: low-fuel alert while fuel was left, services offline, went low power
the client GM menu's abandon timer: abandoned

expect.note: the client changed session (docked, undocked or moved); the clientEval asserts carry the checks
